[SWS_DM_00036] Debounce timer behavior upon reported
kPassed
Upstream requirements:
RS_Diag_04225
⌈
If the
monitor
reports
kPassed
, the DM shall set the debounce timer value to
DiagEventDebounceTimeBased.timePassedThreshold
and process the event
as
kFinallyHealed
.
⌋
